alerts.name: PULBASE staging (1 DOWN, 2 RECOVERED, 3 NO DATA, 4 REVOKE, 5 RETRIES, 6/7/8 OPS, 9 ACK, 10 SLI)
alerts.description: Staging only. Priority 3>1>4>5>10>9>6>7>8>2. 1 DOWN; 2 RECOVERED/30m; 3 no heartbeat/20m; 4 REVOKE; 5 retries>=10. 6 START, 7 LOGIN, 8 CREDIT: estimated failures>=3 AND >=20%/20m, denials excluded. 9 ACK: D1 exact deadline cohorts, missing>=3 AND >=20%/20m; latest snapshot, not sum. 10 SLI NO DATA: query error or snapshot absent/stale>10m. No traffic/no alert is not recovery or monthly SLO. Manual/5m/repeat15m. Cost/usage unchanged.
alerts.query: SELECT CASE WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'v1', 1, 0)) = 0 THEN 3 WHEN argMax(double1, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 1 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1' OR blob3 = 'idle-revocation-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 1 THEN 4 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'revocation-v1', double4 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN sum(if(blob3 = 'start-receipt-v1', 1, 0)) = 0 OR toUnixTimestamp(NOW()) - argMax(double4, if(blob3 = 'start-receipt-v1', double4, 0.0)) > 600 OR argMax(double1, if(blob3 = 'start-receipt-v1', double4, 0.0)) = 10 THEN 10 WHEN argMax(double1, if(blob3 = 'start-receipt-v1', double4, 0.0)) = 9 THEN 9 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-start-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 6 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-login-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 7 WHEN sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) >= 3 AND sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double2 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) * 5 >= sum(if(blob6 = 'operation-credit-v1', double1 * "sampleInterval", 0.0)) THEN 8 WHEN argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) > 0 AND argMax(double4, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) - argMax(double6, if(blob3 = 'v1', double4, 0.0)) < 1800 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM events.analyticsEngine.pulbase_service_health WHERE accountTag = '60e5472a284dc71bbafbbfac8aa2a940' AND blob1 = 'staging' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20' MINUTE
